human_pressure.one_screen_brief: 8085 currently overloads RootCause.UNKNOWN with evidence-backed governance stops, review-required states and non-terminal lifecycle states. It can also diagnose outcome=BLOCKED plus lifecycle=FAILED as process supervision failure when governance signals are absent. Repair the diagnosis contract so UNKNOWN means genuinely unclassified/insufficient evidence only, known governance states remain structured, and governed outcomes are classified before generic lifecycle failure. Keep the repair small and advisory; do not change projection or signal semantics.
human_pressure.why_now: 8086 consumes RootCause structurally. The current UNKNOWN overload turns proven governance facts into unproven failures, breaks recurrence grouping and can downgrade a critical authority STOP into generic human review.
do_not_misread: Do not invent more specific authority/approval/budget causes when only a generic governed outcome is available.
Do not parse root_cause_detail to recover classification; classification must live in RootCause.
Do not change governance projection semantics to make diagnosis easier.
Do not add remediation execution; diagnosis remains read-only and advisory.
red_lines: No automatic remediation or pack mutation.
Do not weaken existing authority, approval, budget, scope or validation gates.

machine_core.goal: Make structured run diagnosis preserve proven governance semantics and reserve RootCause.UNKNOWN for genuinely insufficient or unclassified evidence.
red_lines: RootCause.UNKNOWN must not represent a known governance stop, known review-required state, or known non-terminal lifecycle state.
Do not infer a specific governance subtype from Outcome.BLOCKED or Outcome.REVIEW_REQUIRED when no structured subtype evidence exists.
Governed outcome evidence must be considered before generic lifecycle==FAILED process-supervision classification.
Do not make root_cause_detail authoritative for class recovery.
invariants: UNKNOWN means genuinely unclassified or insufficient root-cause evidence only.
Explicit authority_violation, approval_denied and budget_exceeded remain distinguishable by structured failure signature detail.
A generic Outcome.BLOCKED is classified as a governed stop, not execution_runtime/process_supervision.
Outcome.REVIEW_REQUIRED is classified as review required when no stronger conflicting diagnosis applies.
Lifecycle.RUNNING or Lifecycle.UNKNOWN is represented as NON_TERMINAL rather than UNKNOWN.
Scope, validation and evidence-inconsistency precedence remains unchanged.

observable_effect.assertion: Evidence-backed governed stop, review-required and non-terminal states receive explicit RootCause classes; UNKNOWN is emitted only when no known class is proven.

proofs.assertion: Outcome.BLOCKED with lifecycle=FAILED and no signals does not diagnose process supervision; it yields GOVERNED_STOP with only generic detail unless a structured subtype is proven.
authority_violation, approval_denied and budget_exceeded yield RootCause.GOVERNED_STOP and preserve their structured signal type in root_cause_detail.
review-required signals or Outcome.REVIEW_REQUIRED yield RootCause.REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than UNKNOWN.
RUNNING/UNKNOWN lifecycle yields RootCause.NON_TERMINAL rather than UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN remains available only for the final no-known-class/insufficient-evidence fallback.

failure_semantics: If canonical evidence is contradictory, keep EVIDENCE_INCONSISTENT and human review rather than selecting a convenient governance class.
If a generic governed outcome is known but its subtype is not, classify the broad governed state and keep subtype detail generic.
If no known class is proven, keep UNKNOWN; do not invent a cause from lifecycle prose, producer metadata or logs.

steps.title: Repair the closed RootCause vocabulary
details: Add GOVERNED_STOP, REVIEW_REQUIRED and NON_TERMINAL to RootCause.
Keep UNKNOWN only as the genuine insufficient/unclassified fallback.
Do not remove existing root causes unless a test proves they are unreachable; PACK_DEFINITION cleanup is allowed only if it is demonstrably unreferenced and does not expand scope.

steps.title: Classify governed outcomes before runtime failure
details: After inconsistency/scope/validation and explicit governed-stop/review signal handling, inspect projection.outcome before lifecycle==FAILED.
Outcome.BLOCKED must yield GOVERNED_STOP even without a subtype signal.
Outcome.REVIEW_REQUIRED must yield REVIEW_REQUIRED even without a subtype signal.
Do not infer authority/approval/budget subtype from outcome alone.

steps.title: Remove local dead branch and lock UNKNOWN invariant
details: Simplify _validation_failure_signals so identical branches are removed without changing behavior.
Add regression tests that fail if known governance states return UNKNOWN.
Add a test that the true fallback still returns UNKNOWN.

steps.title: Prove downstream compatibility without modifying correlation
details: Add focused correlation regression tests only if needed to prove two budget_exceeded diagnoses are no longer unproven and authority_violation remains structurally separate from budget_exceeded.
Do not modify run_failure_correlation.py in this pack.

acceptance: RootCause includes GOVERNED_STOP, REVIEW_REQUIRED and NON_TERMINAL.
Outcome.BLOCKED plus lifecycle=FAILED cannot fall through to execution_runtime/process_supervision.
Known governed-stop/review/non-terminal facts never emit RootCause.UNKNOWN.
Explicit authority_violation and budget_exceeded remain distinct via structured detail and are groupable by 8086.
The duplicate _validation_failure_signals branch is removed without semantic expansion.
Projection, signals and correlation production code are unchanged.
Full tests, ruff and mypy pass.

must_check: UNKNOWN is used only for genuinely unclassified/insufficient root-cause evidence.
Governed stop, review required and non-terminal states have explicit RootCause members.
Outcome.BLOCKED is considered before lifecycle FAILED and cannot be mislabeled as process supervision without stronger contradictory evidence.
Generic outcome evidence does not fabricate an authority/approval/budget subtype.
authority_violation, approval_denied and budget_exceeded remain structurally distinguishable.
No root_cause_detail parsing becomes necessary for recovering the broad root-cause class.
Projection/signals/correlation production semantics remain untouched and all validation passes.
reject_if: Any known governed-stop, review-required or non-terminal state still returns RootCause.UNKNOWN.
Outcome.BLOCKED plus lifecycle FAILED can return execution_runtime/process_supervision without contradictory structured evidence.
The implementation invents a specific governance subtype from outcome alone.
Free-form logs, producer identity or root_cause_detail string parsing becomes authoritative classification evidence.
run_failure_correlation.py, projection.py or signals.py is modified.
Validation fails or forbidden files change.
